title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 47
description: Ten questions on Genesis 47: Jacob before Pharaoh, Joseph's rule during the famine and Jacob's last request.

questions.text: How many of his brothers did Joseph present to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: From among his brothers Joseph took five men and presented them to Pharaoh.

questions.text: What did Joseph's brothers tell Pharaoh their occupation was?
questions.explanation: When Pharaoh asked their occupation, they said, "Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers."

questions.text: What did Jacob do when he was set before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Joseph brought in Jacob and set him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

answers.text: He gave Pharaoh a present of honey

questions.text: How old did Jacob say he was when Pharaoh asked him?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years."

questions.text: In which land did Joseph give his father and brothers a possession?
questions.explanation: Joseph gave them a possession in the best of the land of Egypt, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

questions.text: What did Joseph ask the Egyptians to give him when their money was gone?
questions.explanation: Joseph said, "Give me your livestock," and gave them bread in exchange for horses, flocks, herds and donkeys.

questions.text: Whose land did Joseph not buy for Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: He didn't buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh.

questions.text: What part of the harvest did Joseph say the people must give to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Joseph said that at the harvests they should give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts would be their own.

questions.text: How many years did Jacob live in the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 47:28 says Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years.

questions.text: What did Israel ask Joseph not to do when he died?
questions.explanation: Israel asked Joseph, "Please don't bury me in Egypt," but to bury him in his fathers' burying place.

answers.text: Divide his flocks among his sons
